settings.title: Office settings
settings.modulesHint: Enabled services and the monthly fee. Support sets the catalogue and the discount.
settings.modulesEmpty: No paid service yet. Support turns them on.
settings.intro: Deadlines are not hardcoded. Each office sets the days here.
settings.sendTranslated: Email and WhatsApp go out in the client’s language. The original stays in the file.
settings.poderDays: Power of attorney — days before expiry
settings.nudgeDays: Ask again — days since the last request
settings.staleDays: Stale file — days without movement (0 = off)
settings.loadError: Office settings could not be loaded.
settings.blockOrderHint: The arrows change order. This is not a free page builder.
settings.staffLocaleHint: This is only for you. The client language lives on their card.
settings.cronHint: Draft reminders are prepared every morning at 07:00 Madrid. You send them, not the cron.
settings.accountHint: Sign-out and password apply only to you, not the office.
settings.accountImpersonationHint: You are in support mode. The password is not changed here.
settings.teamHint: The owner invites a gestor or asistente. Three people at most. An asistente cannot hide a file.
settings.inviteNoEmail: They are in the office. The invite email did not go out — they set a password with Forgot password on the login screen.
settings.inviteRedirect: Auth rejected the invite link. Add https://sanfolio.app/reset-password to Redirect URLs.
settings.alreadyMember: This email is already in the office.
settings.alreadyRegistered: This email already has an account. Invite again — they join the office with their existing password.
settings.memberAdded: This account already exists — they are in the office. They sign in with their password.
settings.teamFull: This office already has three people.

auth.intro: Office sign-in. Support accounts enter only via impersonation.
auth.passwordUnchanged: The new password must differ from the current one.
auth.forbidden: Support accounts belong here only after impersonation from the Support app.
auth.forbiddenHint: This is the office app. A Support account belongs in the Support app ({supportUrl}), then impersonation into the office.
auth.paymentRequired: This office licence is not active.
auth.resetSent: If the account exists, an email with a link will arrive. Check spam too.
auth.resetError: The reset link could not be sent.
auth.resetIntro: Enter a new password for your account.
auth.resetNeedLink: Open the link from the email. Here you only set the new password, or request the link again.
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.updatePasswordError: The password could not be saved.
auth.emailNotConfirmed: This email is not confirmed yet.

impersonation.missingToken: The URL hash is missing refresh_token. The other origin has no session without it.
impersonation.sessionClosed: The support session is closed or expired.

inbox.title: Today
inbox.empty: No deadlines or gaps. Open a folder or create a client.
inbox.askedRecently: You already asked. The next draft waits for the office interval.
inbox.noChannel: This client has no email or phone.
inbox.snoozeHint: The row leaves today. The deadline itself stays. Nothing is deleted.
inbox.manualSaved: The deadline is in the inbox.

prepis.title: Transcripts
prepis.subtitle: A proposal from the paper. You save it — nothing writes itself.
prepis.empty: No transcript is waiting. New PDFs from mail land here after reading.
prepis.loadError: Could not load the transcript queue.
prepis.saveError: Could not save the proposal to the folder.
prepis.saved: The transcript is on the desk.
prepis.failed: The transcript failed. You can discard the proposal.

stoh.title: Paper stack
stoh.subtitle: Upload scans from the paper folder. The system suggests a block; you save.
stoh.empty: No scan yet. Attach PDFs or photos at once.
stoh.hint: Up to 40 files. One file is one paper (PDFs are not split).
stoh.failed: Could not read it. Place it yourself, or discard the file.
stoh.saved: The paper is on the desk.
stoh.newHint: 1. You have the name. 2. Upload the folder. 3. Confirm where each paper belongs.

ofertas.settingsHint: 2–5 tariffs you actually switch. This is not a market comparator.
ofertas.title: Name
ofertas.empty: No offer yet. Add the tariffs the office actually switches.
ofertas.saveError: Could not save the offer. Fill in a name and a price.
ofertas.noPrice: Invoices do not yet show what the client pays.
ofertas.noOffers: The office has no offer for this block yet.
ofertas.overpayBadge: {count} clients pay more than your offer
ofertas.overpayHint: Only saved invoices and office tariffs. Nothing sends itself.
ofertas.overpayEmpty: Nobody overpays your tariffs from invoices — or Guardar and Settings offers are still missing.
ofertas.overpayLoadError: Could not load the overpay list.

packs.campaignBadge: {count} on the desk (210, after the notary, IBI, expiry)
packs.campaignHint: Open modelo 210 files with no filing date, purchases still pending after the escritura, IBI/SUMA without a recibo, and IDs or policies that expire. AEAT is not filed. Nothing sends itself.
packs.seasonHint: Open 210 files with no filing date. AEAT is not filed automatically. Bulk Pedir prepares drafts; you send them.
packs.seasonEmpty: No open 210 without a filing date.
packs.notaryBadge: {count} purchases still need work after the notary
packs.notaryHint: Purchases with an escritura date where plusvalía is still open, water/electricity/gas/community is incomplete, or a purchase in the last 90 days has no 210. Nothing sends itself.
packs.notaryEmpty: No purchase is waiting on the post-notary checklist.
packs.notaryLoadError: Could not load the after-notary list.
packs.bulkPedirConfirm: Prepare {draft} requests as drafts? {noChannel} without email or phone and {recent} asked recently will be skipped. You send them.
packs.bulkPedirNone: No one to ask. Either there is no channel, or you already asked within the office interval.
packs.bulkPedirDone: Prepared {draft} drafts. You send them. Skipped: {noChannel} with no channel, {recent} asked recently.
packs.expiryHint: DNI, passport, poder and seguro in the office warning window. Same chip as on the card.
packs.expiryLoadError: Could not load the expiry list.
packs.ibiEmpty: No IBI waiting now. Set the due date in Settings, or the recibo is already in and outside the window.
packs.ibiLoadError: Could not load the IBI list.

clients.title: Clients
clients.importHint: The template has a nombre column. NIE is optional. An existing number is skipped; nothing is deleted. Import does not open 500 paper stacks.
clients.importConfirm: Create {ready} folders? {empty} without a name and {dup} with an existing NIE will be skipped.
clients.importDone: Created {created}. Skipped: {empty} without a name, {dup} existing NIE, {errors} errors.
clients.importNone: Nobody to create. Add a name, or the NIE is already in the office.
clients.importEmptyFile: Choose a CSV with a nombre column. The file is empty or not loaded yet.
clients.importBadHeader: The first row needs a nombre column (or name).
clients.name: Name
clients.cardLoadError: Could not load the client card.
clients.softDeleteHint: The client leaves the Clients list — not just the Inactive filter. Papers, files and the audit stay. The office owner can restore it.
clients.softDeleteConfirm: The client leaves the Clients list. Papers, files and the audit stay. The owner can restore it.
clients.onlyOwnerRestore: Only the office owner can restore it.
clients.reachBadge: {count} cards without a channel or language
clients.reachHint: Pedir and the portal need an email, phone or language on the card. A second contact is enough for Pedir. The button fills empty card fields; nothing is sent.
clients.reachEmpty: Every card has a channel and a language.
clients.reachLoadError: Could not load the gap list.
clients.reachCopyNone: The contact has nothing to copy.
clients.reachCopyError: Could not copy from the contact.
clients.mergeHint: Suggestions after CSV: same email, phone, or name without NIE. Two live NIEs are not merged. The second card is hidden; papers stay. AI does not merge.
clients.mergeForbidden: Only the owner and gestor can merge.

mergeReason.name: Same name, at least one card without NIE

clients.mergeConfirm: The second card disappears from the list (soft-delete). Papers and files stay on the first. Two different live NIEs are not merged.
clients.mergeDone: Merged. The second card is hidden.
clients.mergeNieConflict: Two cards with different live NIEs are not merged.
clients.documentsEmpty: No DNI, NIE or passport yet.
clients.legalHoldActive: Legal hold until {date}. The original and anonymisation are locked.
clients.anonymizeHint: Name and NIE become ANON, files are purged, files of record stay as a skeleton. This cannot be undone. A legal hold blocks the button.
clients.anonymizeConfirm: This deletes this card’s PII. Type ANON.
clients.anonymizeBlocked: Release or wait out the legal hold first.
clients.holdSaveError: Could not save the legal hold.

audit.title: Audit
audit.hint: Who opened the card, the folder or a file. Uploads show which document. Entries are never deleted.
audit.loadError: Could not load the audit log.

posta.filed: Filed an attachment in the folder

messages.title: Message
messages.intro: You write in Spanish. The original stays in the file. Translation to the client language comes with the translator; for now the same text goes out.
messages.subject: Subject
messages.sendFallbackGmail: Sending from the office is not on yet. Gmail will open.
messages.historyEmpty: No draft or sent request yet.
messages.discardConfirm: The draft is hidden. The audit trail stays.

posta.title: Mail
posta.subtitle: Link the email to a client and file the attachment in their folder. Send the request from the office; leave free replies in Gmail.
posta.assignError: The client could not be linked.
posta.ignoreError: The email could not be ignored.
posta.suggestHint: The next email from this address lands on the same card.
posta.fileHint: Ranked from the filename and email text. You confirm.
posta.noiseHint: This is Gmail’s forwarding confirmation, not a client paper. Ignore it.
posta.filed: The attachment is in the folder.
posta.filedExtract: The attachment is in the folder. The assistant is reading the paper in the background.
posta.fileError: The attachment could not be filed.
posta.badge: {count} emails with attachments and no client
posta.badgeUnfiled: {count} linked emails with attachments still off the desk
posta.cardHint: Emails from this client and messages the office sent them. Link new ones in Mail.
posta.cardEmpty: No linked email yet. Assign it to this card in Mail.
posta.cardUnfiled: {count} files are not on the desk yet.
posta.ingestHint: The office inbox is Reply-To. Gmail forwards a copy here for filing.
posta.officeEmailHint: This is where the client hits Reply. It must be the mailbox that forwards here.
posta.officeEmailMissing: Add the office email in Settings. Otherwise the client replies to a technical address.
posta.ingestStep2: Gmail → Settings → Forwarding and POP/IMAP → add this address.
posta.ingestStep3: Confirm the link Gmail sends. Private mail does not belong here.
posta.ingestStep4: Office requests use the office inbox as Reply-To. Gmail forwards the copy here so a PDF lands in Mail.
posta.ingestManyOffices: Each office has its own address on inbound.sanfolio.app. Twenty offices means twenty addresses in the system, not twenty mailboxes to buy.

match.plus_address: Matched from the folder Reply-To address.
match.from_name: Matched by sender name — check the card.

posta.markedDone: Mail is recorded. It stays on the card.
posta.doneNeedFile: File the attachments to the desk first.
posta.searchMail: Search name, email, subject or body
posta.shortcuts: J/K list · F file · A assign · D recorded · I ignore · / search
posta.officePhoneHint: Added to the signature of outbound mail.

folder.title: Folder
folder.subtitle: The same two sheets. The pencil is the switch.
folder.offBlocksHint: Switched-off blocks sit at the bottom so the folder starts with what the office actually does.
folder.nameMismatch: The name on the document ({doc}) does not match the card ({card}). Check that the file belongs to this client.
folder.deedPartiesSkipped: The transcript is on the file. Parties and property were not written — the deed does not match this card.
folder.applyMismatch: The transcript is on the file. The card identity was not changed — the name on the document does not match.
folder.nieTaken: NIE {nie} already belongs to another card. The contact was saved; this number was not.
folder.persistError: The folder did not save. Your typing is still there — try the field again.
folder.bloqueToggleError: Could not turn the service on or off. Your switch is unchanged.
folder.coOwnerSaveError: Could not create the co-owner card. The titular on the finca stayed.
folder.coOwnerLinked: A card in the office already had this NIE. We linked it instead of creating a new one.
folder.requiredDocsAny: A contract or an invoice is enough: {types}
folder.removeConfirm: The document will be hidden from the folder. The file stays in storage.
folder.fileTooBig: The file is larger than 32 MB.
folder.fileType: Attach a PDF or a photo (JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC).
folder.fileEmpty: The file could not be read. Save it to Downloads and try again.
folder.extractError: The file is in the folder. The transcript could not be read — open it and save the fields yourself.
folder.transcriptEmpty: The transcript is not saved yet. You save the proposal.
folder.purged: The original file was purged. The transcript remains.
folder.trashHint: Hidden papers from the card and the folder. Purging removes the file. The transcript and audit stay.
folder.purgeConfirm: The file in Storage will be deleted. The transcript and audit stay. The original cannot be restored.
folder.legalHold: This document is under legal hold. The original must not be purged.
folder.purgeWarnLegal: This is an official paper (escritura / tax). The original will no longer open.
folder.watchToggle: Watch this block. Turning it off moves it to Not tracking.
folder.offReason: Why are you turning this block off?
folder.titularEmpty: After saving the deed, buyers and sellers appear here. The pencil corrects name, NIE and share.
folder.titularNieTaken: Another titular on this finca already has this NIE.

fields.adminValue: Value checked by the tax office (€)

expedientes.title: Files
expedientes.intro: Checklist and a deadline. No tax calculation.
expedientes.intro210: Checklist, deadline and IRNR calculation. Filing with AEAT comes after you confirm the figure.
expedientes.introTramite: Status, appointment and papers. Not a second purchase folder.
expedientes.noInmuebleHint: Open a purchase on the client card — modelo 210 belongs to a property.
expedientes.softDeleteConfirm: The file leaves the list. History stays.
expedientes.asistenteNoDelete: An asistente cannot hide a file.

provision.hint: Three numbers from movements. An issued invoice with a card lands here. VAT and Verifactu stay in the book.
provision.owingHint: Retainer remaining is zero or less (received minus invoiced). An empty folder with no movements does not belong here. Nothing sends itself.
provision.owingEmpty: Nobody owes the office right now.
provision.owingLoadError: Could not load the owing list.

citas.title: Appointments
citas.hint: Police, town hall, NIE and notary in one day. A snoozed plazo still counts — the appointment is that day. Nothing sends itself.
citas.loadError: Could not load the appointment list.

ai.title: Assistant
ai.intro: It searches clients and proposes fields from text or a photo. You save. Nothing writes or sends by itself.
ai.input: NIE, name, or text to propose from
ai.extractEmpty: Nothing could be read from the document. No proposal was saved.
ai.noHoles: This folder has no gap to ask about.
ai.prefill: Open the folder with the proposal
ai.factsEmpty: This client has no saved document fields yet. Attach a file and save the proposal first.
ai.officeEmpty: Nothing matching is filled on the desks, or the PDF transcript is not saved yet. Chat does not invent clauses.
ai.officePartial: I only read what is saved on the desk.
ai.fileOnly: The file is in the folder. Fields will appear as a proposal — you save.
ai.emptyThread: Ask about a client, NIE, or a document. You save — nothing is written or sent on its own.
ai.savedHint: This conversation is saved in your office.
ai.writeError: The conversation could not be saved.

tax.title: IRNR calculation (modelo 210)
tax.hint: Pick the income type and residence first. Fields change with what we are calculating. You save the figure.
tax.disclaimer: Whoever clicks Save is responsible for the figure. The system does not file with AEAT.

residency.other: Outside the EU (24%; UK after Brexit goes here)

impute.none: No cadastral value — 50% of the higher figure × 1.1%

tax.imputeHint: Imputation: 1.1% or 2% of cadastral value, cut by days and share. No expenses.
tax.noCadastralHint: No cadastral value: 50% of the higher of acquisition and tax-office value, at 1.1%.
tax.noExpensesOutsideUe: Outside the EU, rental expenses are not deducted. The base is gross rent at 24%.
tax.noAmortHint: 3% amortisation is skipped until construction value is filled (not land).
tax.gainRateHint: Property sale gain: 19% for everyone. The buyer’s 3% withholding is modelo 211.
tax.bought2012Hint: Acquired 12 May 2012–31 Dec 2012: 50% of the gain is exempt.
tax.withholdingHint: Modelo 211 withholding is empty — using 3% of the sale price × share.

facturacion.title: Invoices
facturacion.receivedHint: Office book. AI only prefills; Guardar is the gestor. No SIF / AEAT.
facturacion.issuedHint: Draft. Emitir sends to Verifacti. Verify pulls AEAT status. The key stays in Edge.
facturacion.attachReceivedHint: PDF or photo for {name}. Save the proposal on the card.
facturacion.emptyCliente: This card has no received invoice in the book yet.
facturacion.emptyIssuedCliente: No issued invoice on this card yet. Pick the client on New invoice.
facturacion.cardHint: An issued invoice with a card lands here and on the folder retainer. A received one after Guardar on the paper.
facturacion.extractPending: Proposal is running. Open the document and tap Guardar.
facturacion.aeatHint: Verify the same code on the AEAT test site.
facturacion.emitPending: Queued at Verifacti. Tap Verify in a moment.
facturacion.emitError: The SIF rejected the draft. See the row status.
facturacion.verifyPending: Still queued. Verify again in a moment.
facturacion.verifyRejected: AEAT rejected the record. See the row.
facturacion.sifNotConfigured: SIF API is not set in Edge yet. The draft stays in the book.
facturacion.emisorNifRequired: Add the issuer NIF in Settings.
facturacion.destinatarioRequired: F1 needs the recipient name and NIF.
facturacion.notSubmitted: Emitir first — verify only after submit.
facturacion.sifInFlight: A previous submit is still running. Verify in a moment.
facturacion.settingsHint: Office NIF for later Emitir. VeriFactu lives in Edge, not in Sanfolio core.
facturacion.composeHint: Pick a client from the list, or type every field. Emitir sends the record to Verifacti.
facturacion.emisorMissing: Add the office NIF in Settings, otherwise Emitir will fail.
facturacion.tipoF1Hint: Full invoice. Needs the recipient name and NIF / NIE.
facturacion.destinatarioHint: From the client list, or type the name and NIF here. Fields stay editable.
facturacion.lineasHint: Quantity × price excluding VAT. Discount is a line percent. Rates are summed for AEAT.
facturacion.conceptoHint: Operation description for Verifacti. Empty = first line.
facturacion.linesRequired: Add at least one line with an amount.
facturacion.numeroFechaRequired: Fill in the invoice number and date.
facturacion.libroHint: New books (presupuestos, recurrentes, proveedores) land here, not on the left rail.
facturacion.verifactuHint: QR and AEAT link. There is no accounts journal here.
facturacion.detailIssuedHint: Office paper. Imprimir opens an A4 print with Spanish fields and the Verifactu QR.
facturacion.detailReceivedHint: Book entry. The original PDF lives on the client folder — we do not reprint a received invoice.
